fact: Parakou municipal officials named formalising land transactions through e-Foncier Bénin and adding platform functions for recasement attestations, mutation certificates and compulsions as next steps (reported by Matin Libre).
Fraternité states that with the cadastre registration certificate a parcel can be sold legally at the mairie and that all operations are done directly in e-Foncier Bénin.

La Nation reports that the e-Foncier platform has been operational since 1 January 2025 with mairies, notaries and surveyors, and that nine e-Services on service-public.bj included 163 property transfer requests and mortgage registration, with 11,418 online requests from May 2022 to December 2024 (ANDF).

ANDF's PPMEC II project chief said the e-Foncier Bénin platform has functions to register parcels, issue cadastral registration certificates and update records, with 643,993 parcels registered in 12 communes.
Benin's government says the TERRA BENIN and PPMEC II projects launched on 6 November 2026 will develop and improve the e-Foncier Benin platform; no transactions processed on it are stated.
